objective: Continue architecture/runtime optimization for two hours; investigate prior unclassified status 143 exits and strengthen owned-process teardown.

production_changes.behavior: Defer cancellation while killing the owned process group, reaping its direct child and draining logs. Retry unfinished cleanup when cancellation interrupts temporary handler installation. Preserve an existing execution error.

diagnostic_changes: Standard-library-only independent process supervisor records actual wait result, raw signals/exit syscalls and parent cancellation separately from benchmark summaries.
Fault soak adds 24 cleanup-cancellation cases per cycle, including handler setup, quiet/echo logs and primary-error precedence.
Atomically publish fixture descendant PID before the parent injects cancellation.

negative_controls.supervisor_summary_then_sigterm: Complete summary is followed by actual -15; supervision remains failed, with sender information under strace.

remaining_issues_zh: Python 3.12.0 worker 启动 SIGSEGV 未定位；未保存 core，不能判断与历史 GC 崩溃同因。

十五分钟带 faulthandler 复测正常退出，不作为 SIGSEGV 已修复的证明。

Final documentation link check and closeout integrity audit occur after archive creation; their raw evidence is retained in runs artifacts and their results are recorded here.
